items.headline: Stars to shine on Millennium Square for out-of-this-world attraction
items.verifiedUpdate: Leeds City Council has confirmed that Planetarium Go UK will operate a mobile planetarium on Millennium Square from 4 to 26 September 2026, featuring daily screenings of astronomy and science films for all ages, as published 7 August 2026.
items.localReading: Clearly labelled local-business reading: a month-long daily attraction on Millennium Square is expected to increase city-centre footfall during September, potentially benefiting nearby retail, hospitality and service businesses; local photographers and marketing agencies may find opportunities to partner with or promote the event.
items.dateProvenanceNote: RSS feed metadata lists pubDate Fri, 07 Aug 2026 07:56:00 Z. Article date on news listing page confirms 07 Aug 2026.
items.dateSelectionRationale: Source publication date is directly confirmed by RSS and page metadata. No separate original event date was captured for the council announcement itself; the planetarium operational dates (4-26 Sep) are stated in the article.

items.headline: Plans aim to deliver new council housing in Leeds community
items.verifiedUpdate: Leeds City Council has submitted a planning application for 21 affordable apartments on a brownfield site at Wood Lane in Rothwell, designed with low-carbon construction, EV charging and bike storage, as published 7 August 2026.
items.localReading: Clearly labelled local-business reading: the proposed 21-unit development represents a construction opportunity for local builders, carpenters and kitchen fitters; the low-carbon design requirements may favour architects and contractors experienced with sustainable building methods.
items.dateProvenanceNote: RSS feed metadata lists pubDate Fri, 07 Aug 2026 as the publication date. Article page confirms 07 Aug 2026 date.
items.dateSelectionRationale: Source publication date is directly confirmed by RSS metadata. No distinct construction-start or tender date was evidenced beyond the planning submission announcement.

items.headline: Feedback sought on important document for future Mass Transit system
items.verifiedUpdate: Leeds City Council, in partnership with West Yorkshire Combined Authority, is consulting on the draft Spatial Development Framework supporting the proposed Mass Transit system, seeking representations on legal compliance and soundness before independent examination, as published 6 August 2026.
items.localReading: Clearly labelled local-business reading: the Mass Transit SDF envisions concentrating new development around transit stops, which could create planning and construction opportunities for architects and builders near proposed corridors; businesses and developers are explicitly encouraged to respond to the consultation.
items.dateProvenanceNote: RSS feed metadata lists pubDate Thu, 06 Aug 2026 12:27:00 Z. Article page confirms 06 Aug 2026 listing.
items.dateSelectionRationale: Source publication date is directly confirmed by RSS metadata. The consultation period end date was not separately evidenced from this announcement.

items.headline: Lane rental schemes introduced in Leeds, Wakefield and Kirklees
items.verifiedUpdate: Leeds, Wakefield and Kirklees councils are introducing Lane Rental Schemes, charging companies up to £2,500 per day for carrying out roadworks on busy routes during peak times, with DfT approval and a consistent cross-boundary approach, as published 5 August 2026.
items.localReading: Clearly labelled local-business reading: building, carpentry and maintenance firms that regularly work on or near highways in Leeds will need to factor lane-rental charges into project costing and scheduling; the scheme encourages off-peak working and may reduce daytime road-disruption for other businesses.
items.dateProvenanceNote: RSS feed metadata lists pubDate Wed, 05 Aug 2026 11:00:00 Z. Article page confirms 05 Aug 2026 listing.
items.dateSelectionRationale: Source publication date is directly confirmed by RSS metadata. The scheme launch date is stated as 'later this calendar year' without a precise start date evidenced.

items.headline: One year to go! Leeds marks key milestone in build-up to Grand Départ
items.verifiedUpdate: Leeds City Council has marked the one-year countdown to the Grand Départ of the 2027 Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift, which will start on the Headrow on 30 July 2027, with a pop-up event in City Square and a JOY Makers volunteering programme announced, as published 30 July 2026.
items.localReading: Clearly labelled local-business reading: the Tour de France Femmes Grand Départ is a major international event expected to draw large crowds and media attention to Leeds city centre on 30 July 2027, creating opportunities for local photographers, marketing agencies to service event coverage, and for beauty salons and barbers to cater to increased visitor and participant demand.
items.dateProvenanceNote: The article confirms 'July 30 next year' as the Grand Départ date, and the one-year countdown event occurred on 30 July 2026. RSS metadata lists pubDate Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:39:00 Z.
items.dateSelectionRationale: Original event date (30 July 2027) is directly stated in the article text as 'July 30 next year when it hosts the start of stage one'. The source publication date (30 July 2026) marks the announcement of the milestone event.

items.headline: Residents and businesses asked for views on latest flood risk management strategy
items.verifiedUpdate: Leeds City Council is consulting on its updated Local Flood Risk Management Strategy, which details planned resilience measures building on the £200m Leeds Flood Alleviation Scheme, and explicitly invites residents and businesses to respond, as published 24 July 2026.
items.localReading: Clearly labelled local-business reading: the updated flood strategy directly affects property developers, builders and estate agents by outlining flood-resilience expectations for new developments and existing properties; businesses in flood-risk areas are encouraged to prepare for and recover from flood events, which may influence insurance, premises and operational planning.
